bibliographic.title: Blood of Creation
bibliographic.author: Jekyllstein Gray
bibliographic.description:
"Victor Frankenstein has been dead for over a century, yet the spectre of his legacy is still haunting you."

A gothic noir game where you play as a private eye living in a world where Victor Frankenstein, Henry Jekyll, Dorian Gray, and the Invisible Man are all historical figures who used a mysterious substance called the Blood of Creation to unintentionally engineer their downfall. It has since been outlawed, with the members of a clandestine organization called the Society of the Boreal Pyre being particularly dedicated to eradicating it from the face of the Earth.

So why did one of their most dedicated members steal the Blood of Creation and disappear into the night?
